requested: Clear stage identity and best way to set a deadline for each production stage.

current.model: ProjectDeadline currently stores one optional StageKey and dueAt, plus finalDueAt and timerStartedAt.
current.timeFit: 78px input versus88-90px scroll width at both desktop references.

recommendations.title: Identify the dated stage
recommendations.proposal: Use a visible stage name, never only Stage deadline. In this fixture, preserve and label the existing Media deadline. Rename the section Deadlines when it contains a plan for multiple items.
recommendations.basis: Observed ambiguity: source stage=media,17 August18:30; current read/edit labels both say Stage deadline.

recommendations.title: One row per included production stage
recommendations.proposal: List each stage from the project’s current configured production flow with its date/time or Set deadline. Use the current order and Edit/Animation label, include Storyboard only when configured, and preserve dates for hidden stages.
recommendations.basis: User requests per-stage scheduling; Linear supports the named-item/date pattern. The current model has one stage/date pair, so this is a front-end model and UI extension, not merely a style fix.

recommendations.title: Edit dates directly and read complete times
recommendations.proposal: Click an existing date or Set deadline in its row to open the existing picker. Keep an explicit Save/Cancel boundary for the plan draft. Show stored dates and times in full; size the controls without shrinking type.
recommendations.basis: At1440 and1133, each time text input is78px wide while its scroll width is88-90px. The screenshot clips pm. Read mode also omits the stored final-delivery time.
recommendations.classification: Observed fit issue plus proposed interaction refinement

recommendations.title: Keep final delivery and the Videos summary clear
recommendations.proposal: Keep Final delivery as the separate Client commitment. Show the named next outstanding dated item plus Final delivery in the Videos row; clicking it opens the deadlines list. Preserve meaningful existing Media dates separately from the reorderable flow.
recommendations.basis: Current production guidance distinguishes stage work and final Client delivery. Current table already has a direct deadline entry, but its model only summarises one stage/date.

references.observed: Named milestones are listed with their target dates beside them; the project overview also exposes them in a side panel.
references.relevance: Supports a named stage/date list that can be scanned without switching a generic stage selector.
references.limit: Milestones are not Brisk production stages. This does not approve new stage types, stage status rules or date dependencies.

references.observed: A calendar is open beside a named milestone’s Target date.
references.relevance: A date can be edited at the named item rather than losing its context.
references.limit: The screenshot does not establish Brisk save timing. Keep the existing explicit Save/Cancel boundary in this proposal.

references.observed: New Milestone identifies its Title, Start Date and Due Date as separate fields.
references.relevance: Date meaning is tied to an identified item; start and due have distinct meanings.
references.limit: Brisk does not need start dates or the full milestone creation form for this request.

references.observed: A wide timeline places named work items on a calendar grid.
references.relevance: Useful as a broader scheduling comparison.
references.limit: This takes more space and introduces planning complexity beyond setting the few stage deadlines in the drawer. The compact list is the recommended starting point.

preserve: All existing dates and stored times
Existing Media date remains Media; never migrate it to Edit or discard it
Final delivery remains distinct from internal stage dates and Masters readiness
Current configurable order, optional Storyboard and Animation label
Pinned Media outside reorderable production flow
Working-day urgency calculations and current role permissions
Explicit Save/Cancel; no autosave or automatic shifting of other dates

decisions.recommendation: Support a due timestamp per configured production stage while retaining finalDueAt separately. Import the existing single date only to its identified stage/item; other rows stay unset.
Keep existing Media dates as a separately labelled pinned-area row. Do not convert Media into a sequential production stage. This preserves the current fixture and current capability.

For Videos, use the nearest outstanding dated item and show its name, with Final delivery separately. Exclude completed/hidden stage dates from the next-action summary while retaining their data. Confirm this derivation before implementation because filters/urgency depend on it.

Retain current date/time semantics and stored times for this pass. Flag suspicious dates after final delivery without silently moving other dates or enforcing chronological non-overlap. No dependency engine or new date-only storage policy.

browser.actions: Opened existing editor from direct query, inspected values, Cancelled without Save, captured read state, restored viewport and closed temporary tab.
